summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of KBS Beauty Saloon. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass covering services (147+ items), stylists (6 incl. 'Any Available'), available-slots (with day_blocked logic), booking creation with server-computed total, manager auth (wrong->401, correct->200, missing header->401), booking status transitions incl. invalid->400, stats endpoint, slot-block create/reflect/delete, service toggle & price update. Frontend: Hero pill 'PREMIUM BEAUTY & WELLNESS SANCTUARY' + 4.9 Top Rated + K logo navbar all render correctly. Menu has 8 category tabs + 6 featured cards with Add-to-Added toggle. Reviews section shows all 4 reviewers (Vishwa, Martin, Suchitra, Google Reviewer), 5.0 Google rating and 'STYLED BY NERAJ' video overlay. Full booking flow completed end-to-end (services → stylist → date/slot → details → confirm) producing 'Appointment Request Received' screen with WhatsApp CTA and toast 'Booking placed! Confirmation email sent.'. /admin route login (wrong pw denied, correct pw succeeds) shows created booking with Confirm/Mark Done/Cancel controls.

ui_bugs.issue: Radix warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility'. Add <DialogTitle> (optionally VisuallyHidden) inside DialogContent.

action_items: (Optional/low) Wrap booking modal step headers with Radix <DialogTitle> to silence a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file (~350 lines) — still acceptable but consider splitting routes vs models as it grows.
MongoDB _id is already excluded via projection `{_id: 0}` in all list queries — good.
Email send is best-effort inside try/except with logger.error — good non-blocking behavior for booking POST.
verify_manager compares plain-text password from header; acceptable for MVP shared-secret; consider signed short-lived token if scope grows.
Booking model uses EmailStr from pydantic which requires email-validator; verified working in tests.
Available-slots endpoint hard-codes 10:00–20:00 in 45-min increments — consider making it config-driven.
test_credentials: Manager password: kbs@admin2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, matches backend/.env MANAGER_PASSWORD).
seed_data_creation: Created bookings via API for test coverage (TEST_Automation User x2, TEST_E2E User) plus a temporary slot-block that was deleted at end of its test. All test emails used delivered@resend.dev.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs 15 tests in ~4s. When re-running use `pytest -o addopts=''` because backend/pytest.ini enables xdist LoadScope which splits classes across workers and breaks class-level state (only affects TestBooking.booking_id -> TestManagerBookings). Booking modal uses shadcn <Calendar> (data-testid='booking-calendar'); date buttons before today are disabled — click enabled numeric day buttons. Slot buttons after date pick are plain <button>HH:MM</button>, use get_by_role('button', name='HH:MM'). Details form testids: input-full-name, input-phone, input-email, input-state (native <select>), input-city, input-notes. Advance/submit: booking-next-btn (steps 1-4), booking-submit-btn (confirm step). Stylist testids: stylist-{Name}. Admin route /admin uses manager-password-input and manager-login-btn testids. Booking rows expose confirm-{id}/complete-{id}/cancel-{id}/wa-{id}.
rca of the issue: No bugs found; all requested feature and endpoint checks verified working.
